items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Stock Climbs As Q3 Earnings Mark Return To Profit
items.summary: Moderna came into this Q3 2026 report with a volatile reputation and a rich story stock label, yet the hard numbers just forced a reset. The share price jumped 5.3% to US$254.19 on the first full trading day after results, and this time the move matched something real. The messenger RNA specialist swung to a quarterly profit, posting US$162 million in net income on US$1.3b in revenue. That profit squeeze in reverse is what grabbed the market’s attention. items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Wins Canada Approval For Two MRNA Flu Vaccines
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) received Health Canada authorization for its mRNA influenza vaccine and a combined influenza/COVID-19 shot. Canada is the first country to approve both a standalone Moderna mRNA flu vaccine and the dual flu/COVID-19 product. The approvals expand Moderna's authorized vaccine portfolio in Canada beyond COVID-19 and into seasonal respiratory shots.
